title: Portrait campaign pair
slide_intent: Make real people central to the promise because representation can help a broad audience see a place for themselves.
strategic_value: Portraits with short language-based headlines can connect Duolingo’s mission to individual lives.
demonstration: Two poster designs pair male portraits with the white headlines “c’est possible” and “ciao world”; green and white frames carry the signature and small app badges.
practical_value: Compare how a photographic portrait can carry a headline while retaining a clear branded footer.

content_islands.name: Left portrait poster
content_islands.spec: Place the hat-wearing portrait in a rounded frame on green with the large white headline near its lower edge.

content_islands.name: Right portrait poster
content_islands.spec: Place the red-cap portrait on white with its headline over the lower part of the photo; keep the footer below.

reference_purposes.Intent: The case study says Niall McDiarmid’s portraits of street characters and community members were commissioned to reflect the mission and its impact on people.
reference_purposes.Application: The two posters demonstrate portrait photography combined with headline, signature and app badges.
